engineDependencies.description: Needs the booted DustFlatsTile consumer for the declared tar seams, roads, ORBIT spawn, and dry wash.

Needs a headless Deepwater consumer for claim-boat anchoring and re-anchoring, deck-pad building, the storm and corsair scheduler, the depth ladder, the E5 arsenal, and Dredge-Queen resolution; these run browser-only through DeepwaterClaimTile, DeepwaterArsenal, and DredgeQueenBossSystem.

Needs the declared timed decay-field walkability, six-vein night harvest, epoch-wide appliance wrangle, and Homemaker boss consumers; the browser composes E6TileConsumerSystem, WrangleSystem, and HomemakerBossSystem while the headless sim composes none.

Browser and headless engines compose the atmosphere and suit consumer: outside air drains the suit, breathing domes refill it, empty suits take damage through CombatSystem, and four distinct mining grounds across four air windows gate securing. Native desktop09 and mobile07 complete mining, wave20 secure, banking and reload; evidence is recorded in reviews/sol-map-art-repairs-20260908.md. This records the landed gameplay consumer, not full concept-art acceptance or release admission.

BOTH CONSUMERS LANDED AND THE CLAIM IS EARNED: the squall phase machine in both engines (E10S-2, src/systems/E10SquallScheduler.ts, now.squall) and the warmth meter, STOKE action, gutter terminal, doubled mote pressure and secure latch in both engines (E10S-3, src/systems/E10PreserveSystem.ts, now.emberShore.preserve); E10S-4 added the harvestAnchors, the bench seeds, two losing null-floor rows and the public-verb prover, so the map is admitted.
